description.value: Cassette Cafe and Dive Bar is a combined cafe and dive bar on Lower Ganges Road in Ganges, the main village on Salt Spring Island — one of BC's most beloved cycling destinations. It offers a cafe menu alongside a full dive bar menu, with outdoor seating available. For cyclists riding the island's hilly roads, it serves as a convenient stop for food and drinks in the heart of town.
